claims.statement: Tom Allen died in St. Louis on April 5, 1903, from general debility.
claims.excerpt: conducted a small saloon here, died yesterday from general debility.

claims.statement: Tom Allen was born in Birmingham, England, on April 23, 1839.
claims.excerpt: He was born in Birmingham, Eng., April 23, 1839.

claims.statement: Tom Allen had conducted a small saloon in St. Louis for the past 25 years.
claims.excerpt: who for the past 25 years has conducted a small saloon here

claims.statement: Tom Allen was said to be the only pugilist who lost the world's championship, regained it and retired with it.
claims.excerpt: the only pugiliet who lost the world’s championship, regained it and retired with it.

notes: Dateline April 6; died 'yesterday', taken as April 5. Hint ('25 years') agrees with this article; 209 says 21 years.
